category: the best movie to watch on a plane

a.why: It's bright and funny enough to hold anyone half-watching, and I've seen it ten times so missing a scene on a tiny screen costs me nothing.
a.raw:
PICK: The Incredibles
BECAUSE: It's bright and funny enough to hold anyone half-watching, and I've seen it ten times so missing a scene on a tiny screen costs me nothing.

b.why: Nothing cures the boredom of cruising altitude quite like absolute, white-knuckle perspective on your fellow passengers.
b.raw:
PICK: United 93
BECAUSE: Nothing cures the boredom of cruising altitude quite like absolute, white-knuckle perspective on your fellow passengers.

c.why: Its wordless visuals transcend language barriers and engine noise.
c.raw:
PICK: Koyaanisqatsi
BECAUSE: Its wordless visuals transcend language barriers and engine noise.

a.why: Nobody wants to watch a terrifying 9/11 hijacking movie while trapped on a plane — that's just cruel.

b.why: Watching two hours of slow-motion factory footage with no talking or plot will just put you to sleep instead of keeping you entertained.

c.why: Watching a real plane crash movie while you are flying is way too creepy and stressful.
